verdicts.reason: All five resched helpers (scheduler_ipi, set_need_resched_current, cond_resched, cond_resched_lock, need_resched) match the claim.
enqueue_task_fair uses enqueue_hierarchy, dequeue_task_fair delegates to __dequeue_task, and find_energy_efficient_cpu evaluates perf_domains.
Fragments define the constants, but TASK_UNINTERRUPTIBLE/TASK_DEAD fragments are absent and nothing in the fragments establishes an ABI contract.
Fixed-point, nice, RT, and RR_TIMESLICE macros are shown, but fragments for rq_pin_lock, wait_task_inactive, and __task_needs_rq_lock are missing.

overall: Findings 5 and 6 are fully supported by the cited scheduler fragments; findings 7 and 8 are only partially supported due to omitted fragments beyond the sixth citation and unsubstantiated ABI framing in finding 7.
